page.notes: Entries are printed in two columns; each line above joins the left and right column with " | ". The running head "INDEX." is printed at the top and is given as the running head. No page number is printed. The catchword "Nico" is at the lower right and is kept out of the text. Doubtful readings: "Tolctinus" (possibly Toletanus or similar) and "Nahum locus" (the first letters are hard to make out at the scan's blur). Several small letters in the scan are blurred, so spellings such as "Brekspeare" and "Haflefragus" are copied as the scan shows them. Printed "s" is given as s throughout.
